# Wave 4 verified evidence and boundaries

Sources 41–45 were retrieved on 2026-10-14. Exact received-byte hashes and selected
review scopes are in [provenance](retrieval-provenance.json); stable bibliography
numbers are in [ledger](source-ledger.json). Full texts remain in scratch, not
vendored into the Atlas.

| Ledger ID | Reviewed scope | Not supported by that source |
|---|---|---|
| 41 | Official Spark 3.5.6: caching, adaptive coalescing, skew-join split/replication | ER recall, whole-cluster correctness or a preferred distributed stack |
| 42 | Official PostgreSQL 17: EXPLAIN estimates, actual execution and caveats | Safe permission for modifying probes or universal database superiority |
| 43 | Primary 2015 technical-debt paper: title/authors, section 7 threshold/external-world/monitoring discussion | ER-specific drift estimator, automatic response or measured Atlas gains |
| 44 | AI RMF 1.0, January 2023: MEASURE 2.3–2.5 and 3.1–3.3 | Latest-version claim, ER accuracy, regulatory compliance or deployment permission |
| 45 | Privacy Framework 1.0, January 2020: CT.DM-P and CT.DP-P entries | Latest-version claim, legal obligations or cryptographic/federated guarantees |

Initial NIST HTTP 403 was recovered with a browser-style User-Agent. Host
pdftotext was absent; the existing isolated pypdf environment extracted selected
prose. Source 43 emitted missing-fontTools warnings; no glyph-dependent claim was
imported. The first extraction script had a newline-escaping syntax error and
was corrected; no failed extraction is represented as evidence. Citation support
is scoped review, not proof of every statement in the publications. Physical
coverage, monitoring design, lifecycle witnesses and governance comparisons are
explicit conditional Atlas synthesis. No ER workload, index, model or security
experiment was run.
